prompt:
Analyze this Export Data page implementation and provide specific UX/UI improvement recommendations:

CURRENT EXPORT DATA FEATURES:
- AI-powered export templates with different formats (JSON, CSV, PDF, XML, XLSX)
- AI-generated insights and recommendations for export optimization
- Template selection with section customization
- Preview functionality for export results
- Risk scoring and AI tagging for files
- Scheduled exports capability
- Export progress tracking

TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION:
- React functional components with hooks
- AI-powered data processing and insights generation
- Multiple export format support
- Risk scoring algorithms
- Template-based export system
- CSS modules for styling

CURRENT UX ISSUES TO ADDRESS:
- Limited export customization options
- Basic template system without user-defined templates
- No real-time export progress visualization
- Limited sharing and collaboration features
- No export history or management system
- Missing mobile optimization and touch interactions
- No advanced filtering or data selection options

Provide 3-5 specific, actionable improvements focusing on:
1. Enhanced template management and customization
2. Real-time export progress and visualization
3. Advanced data selection and filtering options
4. Export history and sharing capabilities
5. Mobile experience and touch interactions

Keep response concise and implementation-focused.
